subject: Invitation: $event_name - University Alumni Event
body:
Dear Alumni,

We are pleased to invite you to our upcoming alumni event:

Event: $event_name
Date: $event_date
Location: $event_location

This is a wonderful opportunity to reconnect with fellow alumni and stay engaged with the university community.

To RSVP for this event, please log in to the Alumni Portal or reply to this email.

We hope to see you there!

Best regards,
The Alumni Relations Team
